verdict.rationale: Morph's custom Reflexes let you send your own labeled examples, train a small text classifier in about 30 seconds, and then classify text against it on Morph. That is training on your own data with serving on the same platform. It is limited to small classifiers, though: nothing shows fine-tuning a selectable base chat model and serving it, and dedicated endpoints only reserve capacity for existing models. Missing for 10: fine-tuning of supported base/chat models, choice of base model, serving fine-tuned models via chat endpoints or dedicated endpoints, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can fine-tune a supported base model on my own data and serve the result on the same platform

citations.quote: Send labeled examples, get back a text classifier. Create a job, poll until it finishes, then classify text against it.
A small Reflex trains in about 30 seconds.
